text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَلَٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction attaching the counterfactual to the preceding scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the counterfactual to the preceding scene, so the question of one community is heard as an answer to the divided outcome already in view (42:7). The particle makes divine non-imposition part of the ongoing argument rather than a detached theological statement.

topics.headline: connected counterfactual opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not begin a free-standing abstraction; it resumes the prior outcome and turns it into an explanation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this as the prefixed conjunction of the condition particle, and the CRITICAL rows consistently treat it as a resumptive link to the prior discourse.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual condition particle marking unrealized divine possibility

words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) sets a closed counterfactual frame before the perfect verb {{ar:شَاءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}). The following answer-lām makes one community a certain result only inside that unreal scenario, so the ayah rewinds from the divided outcome of 42:7 to explain why imposed sameness was not the chosen route.

topics.headline: unreal condition sets the argumentative mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that compulsory unity is presented as possible under divine will but deliberately outside the actual order of the ayah.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks words 1-4 as the protasis and words 5-8 as the lām-marked apodosis; the CRITICAL rows use that syntax to keep the unity clause unrealized.

words.gloss_range: perfect will-verb under counterfactual scope with its content supplied by the apodosis
words.root_gloss_range: will, intending, selecting a possible thing; here the possible thing is imposed communal unity

words.prose: {{ar:شَاءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}) leaves its object unspoken until {{ar:لَجَعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:la-jaʿalahum}}) supplies the content: making them one community. The perfect form under {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) marks a complete possible act withheld from realization, while the repeated will-root later in {{ar:يَشَاءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) shifts from unmade total unity to ongoing mercy-selection. Parallels such as 5:48 and 16:93 support the one-community motif, but locally the contrast is mercy-entry rather than testing or guidance wording.

topics.headline: will names a possible unity without actualizing it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine will is not vague desire here; the omitted object is filled by the specific unmade outcome of one community.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect verb with the divine name as subject; attachment and contextual rows support an elided object supplied by the apodosis, while V4 sense evidence allows will/selection without making the unreal result actual.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit subject of the counterfactual and recoverable subject of later divine verbs
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with worshipful referent pressure; not a generic class-name in this local use

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is named explicitly at the start, then remains the recoverable agent behind the making, admitting, and willing verbs. The proper name fixes the agency before later ellipsis, and the possessive suffix in {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) returns the mercy-domain to that same named subject. The derivational background of the name may add worshipful pressure, but locally the decisive payoff is determinate divine agency across the whole contrast.

topics.headline: one named agent governs both sides
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast is not between rival powers but between two divine modes: unreal making and actual admission.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the divine name the nominative subject of the first will-verb and the implied subject of the following divine actions; QAC marks it as a proper noun, not an indefinite deity term.

words.prose: The prefixed {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the answer-marker to {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}), not a preposition of purpose, and it is fused onto {{ar:جَعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jaʿalahum}}). It gives the unreal consequence certainty inside the counterfactual frame, so the ayah treats one community as fully within divine capacity but not the selected order.

topics.headline: certainty inside the unreal consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unreal result would have followed decisively; non-unity is not due to inability.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this segment as the apodosis lām before the making verb, blocking a prepositional or purposive reading.

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jaʿalahum}}) binds the making verb to the plural object suffix, pulling the divided humanity of 42:7 into the counterfactual. Its grammar takes that suffix as object and {{ar:أُمَّةً}} ({{tr:ummatan}}) as the result complement, so the unreal act would render or appoint them into one communal configuration. The later {{ar:يُدْخِلُ}} ({{tr:yudkhilu}}) contrasts this total formation with actual admission into mercy.

topics.headline: divided humanity could have been rendered one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual unity is an imposed rendered state for the same humanity just divided in 42:7, not an organic social drift.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supplies the clitic object and result complement, while V4 and CRITICAL rows support the make/render/appoint range without shifting it into the later entry verb.

words.root_gloss_range: community, direction, model, and ordered collectivity; here narrowed to the unreal result complement

words.prose: {{ar:أُمَّةً}} ({{tr:ummatan}}) stands as the accusative result complement after {{ar:جَعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:jaʿalahum}}). Its indefiniteness presents a possible community type, while the root field of directed collectivity keeps the phrase richer than bare numerical grouping. The word also prepares the shift from closed collective formation to the open personal pivot {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}).

topics.headline: community is the rendered result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unreal option is not merely many people becoming alike; it is a directed collective form named as the result of divine making.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this the second object/result complement, and the CRITICAL rows keep the community and directional field locally tied to the one-community counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: feminine accusative adjective agreeing with the result-complement community noun

words.prose: {{ar:وَاحِدَةً}} ({{tr:wāḥidatan}}) agrees with {{ar:أُمَّةً}} ({{tr:ummatan}}) and closes the result phrase as one community. The form makes unity an adjective of the community, not a separate verb of unifying, so the ayah presents a completed collective state only inside the unreal condition. Parallels such as 11:118 and 5:48 sharpen the familiar withheld one-community motif.

topics.headline: one seals the unreal community phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that unity is grammatically attached to the community noun as a sealed unreal result, then contrasted with selective mercy-entry.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark adjective agreement with the accusative feminine noun; CRITICAL rows about unity and one-community parallels survive as local contrast rather than a claim of actual unification.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before {{ar:لَٰكِن}} ({{tr:lākin}}) keeps the discourse continuous as it turns from unreal consequence to actual divine action. The pivot is therefore not a new topic but the answer to the unchosen one-community route.

topics.headline: continuity carries into the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast grows out of the counterfactual rather than restarting the sentence.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the segment as a conjunction prefixed to the adversative particle, matching the CRITICAL rows that treat it as continuity into contrast.

words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِن}} ({{tr:lākin}}) is the hinge of the ayah. After the unreal one-community result, it introduces the finite verbal clause {{ar:يُدْخِلُ}} ({{tr:yudkhilu}}) rather than governing a following accusative noun, and it prevents the counterfactual from swallowing the real action. The contrast is not incapacity versus capacity, but unactualized homogenization versus mercy-entry.

topics.headline: the hinge redirects from imposed unity to mercy-entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivoting from what could have been imposed to what actually happens: admission into mercy.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks words 9-15 as the contrastive verbal clause after the counterfactual apodosis; CRITICAL rows consistently identify this particle as the adversative pivot.

words.root_gloss_range: entering, causing to enter, access, interiority; here actual admission into mercy

words.prose: {{ar:يُدْخِلُ}} ({{tr:yudkhilu}}) carries the actualizing pivot after {{ar:لَٰكِن}} ({{tr:lākin}}). As a Form IV imperfect, it makes entry something caused by the divine agent and presents mercy-admission as the live action after the completed counterfactual verbs, with {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) as the object and {{ar:فِى رَحْمَتِهِ}} ({{tr:fī raḥmatihi}}) as the entered domain. Formulaic parallels such as 45:30 and 76:31 support the mercy-entry pattern, while the local contrast is with {{ar:لَجَعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:la-jaʿalahum}}).

topics.headline: actual divine action is caused entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the replacement for imposed unity is not another collective formation but caused entry of persons into a mercy-domain.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the verb transitive with a person-object and prepositional complement; V4 entry senses support admission/access rather than making the mercy phrase a loose abstraction.

words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is the object of {{ar:يُدْخِلُ}} ({{tr:yudkhilu}}) and the same referent is understood with {{ar:يَشَاءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}). Its open personal force works as both “the one whom” and “whoever,” replacing the closed phrase {{ar:أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً}} ({{tr:ummatan wāḥidatan}}), so the actual order is selective admission rather than imposed communal sameness.

topics.headline: open person replaces closed collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from a closed collective result to an open personal object of mercy-entry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this pronoun the direct object of the entry verb and the shared object understood with the following will-verb; CRITICAL rows preserve both relative and indefinite openness.

words.prose: {{ar:يَشَاءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) completes {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) with divine selection. Unlike the perfect {{ar:شَاءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}) inside the unreal condition, this imperfect keeps selection open in the actual mercy-entry clause. The exact mercy-entry formula in 76:31 confirms the pattern, while locally the elided object is the person admitted: whom He wills, not merely as He wills, and not a new communal state.

topics.headline: will returns as ongoing personal selection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated will-root changing function: it withholds total unity first, then governs personal admission.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect verb in the relative phrase, and attachment evidence links the object back to the pronoun; CRITICAL rows about repeated will are narrowed to this local contrast.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) after the entry verb. Because the verb already carries entrance, the preposition lets mercy function as the containing domain or destination rather than a direct object or merely a reason for admission.

topics.headline: the preposition makes mercy an interior domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is not only an attribute mentioned beside admission; it is the space or domain into which entry is caused.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the mercy noun the prepositional complement of the entry verb, and the CRITICAL rows use that syntax to preserve containment/domain force.

words.prose: {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and carries the possessive suffix back to the named divine agent. The mercy root can evoke sheltering compassion, and the nominal form gives the entered reality stability as a domain. Cross-references such as 4:175 and 42:28 show mercy in wider divine-gift patterns, but here mercy is isolated as the destination after the adversative hinge and contrasted with lack of {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) and {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}).

topics.headline: mercy is the actual destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actual alternative to imposed unity is entry into personally divine mercy, not a neutral collective arrangement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the genitive noun under the preposition with a 3ms suffix; V4 and contextual evidence support mercy-domain language without detaching it from the local entry construction.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final nominal clause with {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimūna}}). It links the wrongdoer statement to the mercy-entry clause while shifting focus from admitted persons to the exposed excluded group.

topics.headline: new clause turns to the excluded group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves directly from mercy-entry to the group exposed outside support, without another adversative hinge.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the segment as the conjunction before a nominative topic; attachment evidence marks the final words as a coordinated negated nominal sentence.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle as fronted topic of the negated support clause
words.root_gloss_range: wrongdoing, injustice, darkness/displaced order; here the identifiable group outside mercy-entry
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimūna}}) begins the final clause as a definite plural participial topic. The form identifies a class of wrongdoers, then the nominal negation describes their settled exposure rather than narrating a new divine verb. The root’s injustice and darkness pressure helps explain why this group stands outside mercy-entry, and surah-local recurrences at 42:21, 42:22, 42:40, 42:41, and 42:42 keep the judgment thread active.

topics.headline: definite wrongdoers become the exposed class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the open object of mercy-entry is followed by a definite class whose supportlessness is statically described.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite masculine sound plural active participle, and attachment evidence makes it the topic of the following negated predicate; CRITICAL echoes to 76:31 and 42:44 are retained as parallels, not as replacements for the local parse.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the negated possession clause over {{ar:لَهُم}} ({{tr:lahum}}) and the paired support nouns. With the later min-plus-indefinite phrase, it denies any protector rather than a particular expected one; with no overt copula, the ending lands as a settled condition: wrongdoers have no available protective or rescuing support.

topics.headline: negation opens a settled deprivation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ending is not another action sequence; it is a static denial of available support.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this as the negative particle before the prepositional predicate, and attachment evidence places the whole final span inside a nominal clause.

words.prose: The {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) of {{ar:لَهُم}} ({{tr:lahum}}) forms the fronted availability predicate. Before any support noun appears, the grammar fixes the issue as what is or is not available to the wrongdoers, shifting from destination language to relational exposure.

topics.headline: availability to them is denied first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first foregrounds what is unavailable to the wrongdoers, then names the denied support roles.
topics.reason: QAC treats the segment as the preposition governing the pronoun, and attachment evidence makes the resulting phrase the predicate frame for the wrongdoer topic.

topics.headline: the pronoun fixes the denied support to wrongdoers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support denial is not generalized to all people; it is scoped to the definite wrongdoer group.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the pronoun to the preposition in the possessive predicate over the wrongdoer topic; CRITICAL rows preserve the antecedent and scope payoff.

words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) appears after {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and before the indefinite {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}). In that negative environment it makes the denial exhaustive: not even one member of the protector class is available to the wrongdoers.

topics.headline: not even one protector is available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first support role is denied categorically, not merely as a known or expected protector.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make this the preposition governing the first support noun after negation; CRITICAL rows about intensification and class-generalizing force are locally licensed.

words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) is indefinite and genitive under {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}), so the clause denies any close protective authority. The root field of nearness and patronage makes the loss relational, not just helpful in a generic way. Its pairing with {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) moves from standing protection to intervention, while 2:257 sharpens the contrast by naming divine patronage for believers.

topics.headline: no close protective authority remains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first denied support is standing protective nearness or authority, distinct from later active rescue.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the noun by the negation-strengthening preposition; V4 sense evidence supports patron/protector nearness, and CRITICAL pair evidence keeps it distinct from the rescue noun.

topics.headline: the second support role stays inside the same denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final helper term is cumulative, not a separate new claim.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this as the conjunction segment before renewed negation, and attachment evidence coordinates the final noun with the first support noun.

topics.headline: rescue is denied separately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second support role is explicitly unavailable, not merely appended to the first noun.
topics.reason: QAC marks this as the negative particle segment before the coordinated noun; CRITICAL rows about renewed negation are supported by the local coordination.

words.prose: {{ar:نَصِيرٍ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) shares the negative case environment of {{ar:وَلِيٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) but names a different support role: active rescue or intervention. Its intensive pattern can mark a reliable helper, and its indefiniteness carries the exhaustive denial through the final word. The pair echoes support formulas such as 22:78 while the ending also links back to 42:7 through the shared final -īr cadence with the prior destination term.

topics.headline: the ayah closes on denied rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sound and final meaning are absence of active rescue, completing the pair after protective nearness is denied.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence coordinate this genitive noun under the same negation; V4 root senses support help/rescue/victory intervention, and CRITICAL rows about the closing pair and cadence remain locally coherent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual "if God willed, He would have made them one community" is opposed by "but He admits whom He wills into His mercy."
baseline_models.mechanism: Unlimited capacity to produce a single collective state is asserted but not enacted. The enacted alternative is causative and spatial: differentiated persons are brought across a boundary into a merciful interior, so uniformity and mercy are not made synonymous.

activation_trace.role: Will related to a possible thing governs both the unrealized universal making and the realized selective admission.
Making as causing a state supplies the unrealized operation of turning all people into one collective condition.
A community gathered by a common matter supplies the collective object of the counterfactual.
Things brought under one aspect supplies the proposed common condition without requiring numerical singularity.
Movement across an inside boundary makes mercy an entered domain rather than only an assigned benefit.
Tenderness and beneficent care characterize the interior into which admission occurs.

changed_reading.before: God could make everyone one group but instead chooses some for mercy.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts totalizing production of one collective condition with differentiated ingress into a domain of care; unity is possible, but mercy operates here through admission rather than homogenization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The phrase "one community" combines ummah with wahidah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The community root can organize people by religion, followed way, or common aim, while oneness can place multiple persons under one aspect. The unrealized possibility is therefore not limited to making one demographic block; it can mean aligning all toward one governing direction.

activation_trace.role: A shared religion or followed way supplies the normative axis around which a community coheres.
Intending and directing oneself toward a target turns communal unity into convergence of orientation.
Unity in one aspect allows a plurality of persons to share one rule or direction.

changed_reading.before: One community means one undifferentiated population.
changed_reading.after: One community can mean a plurality converged on one way, aim, or governing aspect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "admits ... into His mercy" gives mercy an inside, while the mercy root also carries kinship and womb branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative entry supplies enclosure; the mercy inventory supplies tenderness, kin relation, and a womb-like place of formation. Together they support a protected relational interior, not merely an external favorable verdict.

activation_trace.role: Entering an inside supplies the enclosing geometry of the mercy relation.
Tender care supplies the interior's affective and beneficent quality.
Kin relation supplies a durable bond among those held within mercy.
The womb as a containing place of growth supplies the model's strongest material image.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is a benefit bestowed on selected recipients.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is also an entered relation of shelter, kin-making, and formation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wrongdoers are denied both a wali and a nasir.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrongdoing is misplacement or withholding of right. Its consequence is relationally doubled: no adjacent patron remains to hold and govern the affair, and no event-level helper remains to secure vindication. The pair removes both durable standing and tactical rescue.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies wrongdoing as violated order rather than a bare label.
Withholding and confinement from a right supplies the social mechanism that severs legitimate support.
Ongoing charge over an affair supplies durable patronage and governance, which the wrongdoers lack.
Loving alliance and support supply the relational side of the denied protection.
Active aid that makes one prevail supplies the denied intervention.
Vindication after injustice supplies a juridical standing that a wrongdoer cannot claim for the wrongdoing.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers will have no ally or helper.
changed_reading.after: By violating placement and right, wrongdoers lose both sustained legitimate patronage and the standing for a rescuing or vindicating intervention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering a fault protects its bearer from the fault's effect, while pardon removes the punitive trace. Repeated covering and erasure across the surah make the boundary of the focus mercy-space dynamically reopenable rather than a picture of an unexplained, permanently closed class.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the boundary whose accessibility is being reconsidered.
Beneficent tenderness identifies the destination whose access can be restored.
Protective covering of fault supplies a way to preserve a person from the fault's consequence.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies removal of an obstacle to mercy.
Effacement of a trace makes pardon a repeated clearing operation rather than a single exception.

structural_cues: 42:5 places intercession for those on earth beside the divine names of forgiveness and mercy.
42:25 accepts return and pardons faults; 42:30 and 42:34 repeat pardon of much.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: broad intercession, protective covering, accepted return, and repeated erasure. Reader arrow: these operations preserve or reopen ingress to the mercy-space. Live alternative: they may describe effects of mercy without specifying the admission criterion in 42:8.

changed_reading.before: Admission divides a fixed included class from a fixed excluded class.
changed_reading.after: Admission remains sovereign, but the surah portrays fault-covering, return, and erasure as live processes by which access is preserved or reopened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding gathering contains two distinct teams, and the later creation sequence first disperses creatures and then asserts power to gather them. Gathering is thus an operation on plurality, not the same operation as making one community; collection can preserve distinction.

activation_trace.role: A group united by a common matter supplies the counterfactual communal state to be distinguished from mere collection.
Being under one aspect supplies the stronger unifying operation that gathering does not itself entail.
A day or occasion that assembles people supplies a shared venue capable of containing differentiated outcomes.
Distinct teams supply the plurality retained inside the one gathering.
Scattering creatures supplies created dispersion as a positive prior state.
Drawing dispersed beings together supplies eventual collection without asserting erased difference.

structural_cues: 42:7 places one Day of Gathering beside two teams immediately before the focus.
42:29 sequences created dispersal before conditional gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one gathering holds two teams, and scattered creatures can later be gathered. Reader arrow: collection preserves plurality and therefore differs from counterfactual homogenization. Live alternative: eschatological gathering and communal unity may be separate domains with no intended contrast.

changed_reading.before: Divine gathering and making one community are equivalent images of bringing everyone together.
changed_reading.after: The surah distinguishes collecting a plurality from making it one community; God can gather differentiated beings and outcomes without first homogenizing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent contrast opposes adopted patrons to God as the patron and immediately assigns Him life-giving action. Later, rain relief, spreading mercy, and the same patron title converge. The denied wali in the focus is therefore not just any ally but access to a life-bearing, mercy-circulating patronage that substitutes cannot perform.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the durable office denied to wrongdoers.
The repeated root contrasts adopted claimants to charge with the one true holder of the affair.
Life as benefit and good makes revival the patron's positive operation rather than a bare title.
Relief reaching one in distress supplies the concrete rescue distributed by the patron.
Opening and spreading supplies outward circulation of the mercy into which the focus described inward admission.
Supportive patronage names the agent who spreads mercy after distress.

structural_cues: 42:9 answers the question about substitute patrons with an emphatic divine patron and revival of the dead.
42:28 joins rain after despair, spreading mercy, and the divine patron title.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: substitute patrons, the exclusive patron, revival, rain relief, and spread mercy. Reader arrow: the true patron is the channel of life-bearing mercy, so focus denial means loss of that channel. Live alternative: the clauses establish divine monopoly without defining wali through the later rain scene.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers simply lack a friendly ally.
changed_reading.after: Wrongdoers lack the only patronage capable of reviving, relieving, and circulating mercy; adopted alternatives are exposed as functionally empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: A common way is maintained upright and protected from fragmentation, but plurality remains visible through justice between groups, distinct works, and consultation among them. This turns one-community unity into an enacted procedure of shared orientation, fair relation, and deliberation rather than erased agency.

activation_trace.role: A followed religious way supplies the common norm around which the community coheres.
Multiple groups under one governing aspect supply unity without numerical collapse.
Shared obedience and committed practice supply the community's common way.
Upright maintenance supplies ongoing work required to keep the common way standing.
Scattering into parts supplies the failure mode explicitly prohibited within the shared way.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies a relation that can bind distinct parties without making them identical.
Extracting judgment through reciprocal review supplies a participatory procedure for common affairs.

structural_cues: 42:13 commands establishing the shared way and not fragmenting within it.
42:15 combines justice between distinct parties, distinct works, and eventual divine gathering.
42:38 locates communal affairs in consultation among the members.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one shared way, maintenance, anti-fragmentation, justice across parties, and consultation. Reader arrow: these are the procedures by which unity can exist without coerced sameness. Live alternative: they may describe duties within a chosen community rather than define the unrealized one community of 42:8.

changed_reading.before: One community would result from a single act that makes everyone the same.
changed_reading.after: A one-community condition can be procedural: common orientation is kept upright through justice and consultation while distinct persons and works remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later counterfactual has the same shape as the focus: unrestricted expansion could be done, but it would produce transgressive overflow, so actual distribution descends by measure. This supplies a protective logic for withheld totalization: differentiation can preserve limits and moral space rather than signal deficient mercy.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing supplies the shared grammar linking unrealized totalization to actual differentiated action.
Causing a plurality to become one supplies the totalizing operation whose non-enactment receives a protective analogy.
Unrestricted breadth and increase supply the unrealized abundance in the parallel counterfactual.
Crossing the limit through aggression supplies the harmful overflow that full expansion would enable.
Deliberate apportioning with judgment supplies the calibrated alternative to unrestricted expansion.
Keeping a thing within its fitting measure supplies the stabilizing effect of differentiated distribution.

structural_cues: 42:27 repeats the focus pattern "if God had ... but ... what He wills."
The unrealized full expansion is explicitly linked to transgression, while the actual act is measured.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a matched counterfactual, harmful overflow, and measured distribution. Reader arrow: the same protective calibration can illuminate the focus refusal to impose one condition on all. Live alternative: provision and communal formation may obey different reasons, so the analogy need not be causal.

changed_reading.before: Not making all people one appears only as unexplained selective differentiation.
changed_reading.after: The matched counterfactual permits a protective reading: totalization is withheld because measured differentiation can restrain overflow and preserve a morally workable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later legal sequence grants intisar to those struck by aggression and removes any case against one who vindicates himself after being wronged; the actionable path is directed instead against aggressors. The focus does not abolish redress. It denies wrongdoers the standing of the wronged and the rescue attached to that standing.

activation_trace.role: A grievance seeking equity supplies the juridical relation later distributed between wronged claimant and wrongdoer.
Vindication after injustice supplies the specific form of support whose legitimate bearer is clarified later.
Aggressive boundary-crossing supplies the injury that activates legitimate self-vindication.
The wronged party's vindication supplies the positive counterpart to the focus denial.
Vindication after being wronged explicitly assigns the branch to the victim rather than the perpetrator.
The suffered grievance supplies the victim's claim to equity.
An extended actionable path supplies the legal route directed against those who wrong and aggress.

structural_cues: 42:39 gives self-vindication to those struck by aggression.
42:41 removes the case against one who vindicates himself after being wronged.
42:42 places the case against those who wrong people and transgress without right.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: aggression, victim vindication, absence of a case against the victim, and a case against aggressors. Reader arrow: the focus denial of nasir is denial of legitimate vindicatory standing to wrongdoers. Live alternative: the focus may concern ultimate divine rescue while 42:39-42 regulates temporal social redress.

changed_reading.before: The denial of a helper is a general statement that no support can attach to anyone involved in wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The denial is asymmetrical and juridical: redress remains available to the wronged, while wrongdoers cannot convert their aggression into a claim for vindication.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late in the surah, lack of a wali is followed by a request for a route of return; powerless patrons are followed by no path; and the response deadline is followed by no return and no refuge. Patronage and aid become topological capacities to return, traverse, or shelter. This makes focus admission into mercy time-sensitive ingress whose opposite is eventual route closure.

activation_trace.role: Crossing into an inside supplies the open route against which later closure is read.
Uninterrupted proximity supplies the relation that could otherwise keep a route open.
Absent charge over the affair supplies the condition under which the wrongdoers seek a return route too late.
Return to a prior place supplies the requested reversal of the closed trajectory.
Failed active aid supplies the inability of substitute patrons to reopen an escape route.
A traversable way supplies the route explicitly absent after failed patronage.
Protective refuge supplies the shelter no longer reachable after the deadline.

structural_cues: 42:44 sequences no wali, sight of punishment, and a request for a route back.
42:46 sequences powerless patrons and no path.
42:47 commands response before a day with no return and no refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: denied patronage, failed aid, requested return, absent path, and absent refuge. Reader arrow: these are spatial consequences opposite the focus ingress into mercy. Live alternative: the late irreversible scene may state only the final consequence and not define present admission.

changed_reading.before: Entry into mercy is a static allocation, and no patron or helper means social abandonment.
changed_reading.after: Entry is also an open trajectory with a deadline; loss of patronage and aid culminates in no route back, no traversable way, and no shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing creation sequence distributes offspring as gifts, joins sexes, and then closely echoes the focus grammar with making whom He wills infertile. That generative field activates the womb branch of mercy and its enclosing entry, but the infertility clause prevents a crude equation of mercy with biological success. The image is formation and holding, not a fertility reward.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies movement into the containing space activated by the womb image.
The womb as a place of growth supplies a material model for mercy's containing interior.
Gift without exchange supplies the non-contractual distribution of offspring.
Joining one thing as a counterpart to another supplies the generative pairing around the grammatical echo.
Causing someone into a state repeats the focus making operation in the domain of fertility.
Divine willing supplies the close syntactic link between differentiated creation and focus admission.
Infertility in womb and offspring blocks any inference that the womb resonance promises biological fertility.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 distributes female offspring, male offspring, paired offspring, and infertility under repeated divine willing.
42:50 closely echoes the focus with "makes whom He wills" inside a reproductive sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: gift, pairing, womb infertility, and a close making-willing echo. Reader arrow: this field activates the focus mercy root's womb branch as containing formation. Live alternative: the anatomical branch may remain lexical resonance only, with no intended account of mercy.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an abstract favor, perhaps evidenced by favorable life outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Mercy can be imagined as womb-like holding and formation, while the same divine differentiation of fertility forbids treating offspring or fertility as its measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing declaration closely repeats focus lexemes and syntax: God makes revelation light and guides by it whom He wills, while the messenger also guides toward a straight path. The selected outcome is therefore shown with an instrument, illumination, direction, and a human messenger. Mercy-entry can be enacted through mediated disclosure and path-guidance rather than imagined only as unmediated insertion.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the destination-side movement for which later guidance provides a route.
Beneficent care supplies the destination reached through the mediated guidance model.
Causing revelation into the state of light supplies an enacted making that equips rather than homogenizes.
Illumination supplies the medium by which a route and its destination become perceptible.
Gentle indication toward a way supplies the directional process shared by divine and messenger clauses.
The repeated willing construction links guided selection directly back to mercy admission.
A straight traversable road supplies the spatial connector between guidance and entry.

structural_cues: 42:52 repeats making, willing, and selection while adding the instrument "by it."
The verse places divine guidance of whom God wills beside the messenger's guidance toward a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: made light, guidance by that light, repeated divine willing, messenger guidance, and a straight path. Reader arrow: this sequence supplies a mediated route into the focus mercy-space. Live alternative: it may illustrate another selected divine act without specifying how admission in 42:8 occurs.

changed_reading.before: God admits selected persons into mercy by an opaque unilateral transfer.
changed_reading.after: The surah's closing echo presents a mechanism for such admission: revelation is made illuminating, guidance operates through it, and a messenger indicates the traversable path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because nasir normally reads as a personal or juridical helper; valid because its focus inventory includes rain-like irrigation and 42:28 directly joins rain, spread mercy, and the wali. Render only as a secondary ecological resonance, never as a replacement for agentive aid or vindication.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies the wrongdoers a nasir immediately after mercy-entry and beside denial of a wali.

activation_trace.role: Rain that irrigates and relieves supplies an ecological form of the denied rescue.
Life-giving rain descending from above supplies the concrete event that activates the focus rain-rescue branch.
Aid in distress from the non-dominant mapped root makes the rain event simultaneously a rescue event.
Rain reviving dry vegetation supplies the visible spread and effect of mercy.
The supportive patron title binds rain-rescue back to the focus wali-nasir pair.

changed_reading.before: No nasir means no person will come to the wrongdoers' aid.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary ecological register, they also lack a rain-bearing rescue that reaches desiccation with reviving mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates a pastoral drinking branch of dakhala rather than its ordinary ingress sense; valid because the focus verb itself carries that branch and the surah later supplies both an open water source and mercy-rain. Render as a contained material analogy for guided admission, not as a lexical replacement or historical scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus causative "He admits" can activate the branch in which a thirsty camel is inserted among others or returned to drink until its need is completed.

activation_trace.role: Returning thirsty animals to drink or inserting one among others supplies guided admission into a shared life-source.
Care for the needy supplies the motive and quality of the watering admission.
A visible open water source supplies the communal destination toward which admission is directed.
Descending life-giving rain replenishes the material field in which mercy can be imagined as water access.

changed_reading.before: Admission into mercy is an abstract crossing assigned to isolated individuals.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, admission resembles a caretaker placing the thirsty into the communal drinking order so that access to the shared source can be completed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it carries the material honey-gathering branch of shura into a political reading of one community; valid because the focus anchors communal oneness and 42:38 explicitly locates common affairs in shura. Render as an analogy for productive deliberation, not as an etymological definition of consultation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's one community can be tested against the later description of common affairs conducted by consultation.

activation_trace.role: A group held by a common matter supplies the social body whose unity must be produced.
Multiple persons brought under one governing aspect supply the result of successful deliberation.
Gathering honey from its place supplies a material analogy for drawing a shared good from distributed contributions.
Extracting judgment through review supplies the actual social mechanism that contains the honey analogy.

changed_reading.before: A one community would be produced by imposing one condition from above.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, communal oneness can be a shared good extracted through reciprocal consultation from many distinct contributors.

strongest_changes: One community separated from mere gathering: the surah gathers differentiated teams and creatures without first homogenizing them.
Uniformity shifted toward procedural unity maintained by a shared way, justice, and consultation.
The matched counterfactual of 42:27 supplied measured differentiation as a potentially protective alternative to total expansion.
The wali-nasir pair became life-bearing patronage, legitimate redress for the wronged, and eventually a route-or-refuge topology.
The closing made-light and guidance syntax supplied a mediated mechanism for admission into mercy.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence did more than repeat the focus vocabulary: it placed willing, making, mercy, patronage, aid, gathering, and guidance into matched constructions. Hydrological, juridical, generative, and procedural branch images then produced distinct but anchored readings without requiring one final synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the womb, rain-rescue, and watering-place models are intended lexical interplay or only productive branch-level resonance.
Whether the protective calibration of provision in 42:27 can explain communal non-uniformity or merely offers a parallel logic.
Whether the late no-return topology defines present mercy admission or only its final opposite.
How strongly response and return elsewhere in the surah qualify the unelaborated divine willing in 42:8.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Possible uniformity gives way to selective enclosure.** Lexical evidence: ج ع ل `B002` (turning into a state), ء م م `B004` (community), و ح د `B005` (one in a shared respect), د خ ل `B001` (entering), and ر ح م `B003` (womb). Structural cue and role: the unrealized making of one community is contrasted with individual entry into mercy. Abductive move: I infer from the womb branch that **فِى رَحْمَتِهِ** pictures a protected interior rather than an abstract allocation. Reading change: plurality is permitted, while mercy provides another kind of unity through enclosure.

2. **Redress is unavailable to those who withhold or misplace what is due.** Lexical evidence: ظ ل م `B008` (prevention and withholding), و ل ي `B004` (support), and ن ص ر `B002` (redress after oppression). Structural cue and role: the wrongdoers' withholding is answered by absence of both supporting patron and redress. Abductive move: I infer a measure-for-measure social logic: agents who block due relations cannot summon those relations as rescue. Reading change: the final denial is relationally exact, not merely emphatic.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:28's late rain and spread mercy corrected a purely selective reading of entry: divine choice can arrive as an environment opened after collective despair.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mercy as a generative interior.** **Lexical evidence:** ر ح م `B003` (womb), د خ ل `B001` (going in or entering), and ء م م `B004` (community), anchored in يُدْخِلُ ... فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ after أُمَّةً. **Structural cue:** 42:7 has just presented a mother-center, gathering, and divided parties; 42:9 revives the dead; 42:11 forms pairs and multiplies creatures. **Assigned role:** the womb branch makes mercy an interior in which life and community can be generated without compulsory sameness. **Abductive move:** I infer that entry, revival, pairing, and multiplication activate the bodily container image; the text does not identify mercy literally with a womb. **Reading change:** entry into mercy becomes admission to a life-producing enclosure, contrasting with the unrealized coercion of making everyone one community.
2. **True support is not detachable from custody.** **Lexical evidence:** و ل ي `B004` (loyal alliance and support) and ن ص ر `B001` (aid that makes someone prevail), both negated for the wrongdoers. **Structural cue:** 42:6 and 42:9 surround this ayah with adopted versus actual guardianship, and 42:10 locates judgment and reliance with God. **Assigned role:** the paired negations remove both durable affiliation and event-specific aid. **Abductive move:** I infer that support fails because it was detached from the authority governing entry, life, and judgment. **Reading change:** the closing clause denies an entire support architecture, not two near-synonymous helpers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:11's pairs and creature multiplication made the ر ح م `B003` activation much stronger than the initial entry construction alone. 42:13 then showed that generated plurality can share one sustaining way without being made one undifferentiated community.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision moves from an elevated store through controlled release into receiving and distributing structures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Divine apportionment takes concrete form as a water system of clouds, pulses, basins, channels, and allotted irrigation turns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water Is Received and Allotted
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Descending water is caught in hollows and basins, routed through channels, and assigned by turn.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: water-holding basin `quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`; collected water in a large basin `quranic:root_000220:B002/m01`; water gathered in a hollow `quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`; allotted irrigation turn `quranic:root_001249:B007/m01`; distant channels feeding a reservoir `quranic:root_001510:B007/m01`; water gathered at a settlement or basin `quranic:root_001222:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: ء خ ذ at 42:6, 42:9; ج ب ي at 42:13; ج ي ء at 42:14; ق ل د at 42:12; ن ص ر at 42:8; ق ر ي at 42:7.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reception is as structured as release. Hollows collect the flow, channels convey it, and irrigation turns allocate it, so abundance becomes usable only through custody and measure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: New life proceeds by joining, seeding, enclosure, and eventual emergence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coupling and Seeding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Paired bodies join and seed is deposited to initiate generation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a pair joined for mating `quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`; marital spouse `quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`; seed cast into soil `quranic:root_000510:B003/m01`; female animal seeking the male `quranic:root_000248:B009/m01`; seminal fluid `quranic:root_001492:B009/m01`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pairing is rendered as an active generative mechanism: attraction and coupling precede the placement of seed. Agricultural deposition and bodily reproduction share the same functional transition from paired potential to initiated growth.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın açıklaması bir varlığı belirli bir ad veya nitelikle anma ve onun öyle olduğunu söylemedir. Bununla birlikte aynı ifadenin bir başka yorumda o varlığı gerçekten söz konusu duruma getirme diye açıklandığı da kaydedilir; bu yüzden dal ancak bu yorum ayrılığı belirtilerek korunabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye yapacağı iş veya yerine getireceği görev karşılığında ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağanı açıkça tanımlar. İnsanların bir sefer veya önemli iş için aralarında kararlaştırdıkları ortak ödemeler de aynı karşılık belirleme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iş veya görev karşılığında belirlenen ödemedir; genel armağanı, yapılan işi, durum değiştirmeyi ve tencere bezini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad alanına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yapacağı iş veya görev karşılığında ona verilmek üzere belirlenen ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır. Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş için aralarında kararlaştırdığı ödemeler de bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir iş veya görevin yapılması karşılığında bir kişiye ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır.
Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş sırasında kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödemeleri de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iş karşılığında önceden ayrılan ücret veya armağanda birleşir; topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeler bu çekirdeğin özel biçimi olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: iş karşılığı belirlenen ücret veya ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödeme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir kişiye iş için ayrılan karşılığı hem de bir topluluğun önemli iş için kararlaştırdığı ödeme biçimini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: İşe bağlı karşılık belirleme ile ortak ödeme özel durumunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek durum aynıdır, ancak tür kapsamları ayrıdır: odak dal köpek ve yırtıcı dişilere, komşu dal dişi deveye bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; daha geniş hayvan kapsamlı yakın ad ile dişi deveye özgü ad, tür sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söz konusu biçimi doğrudan deve kuşunun yavrusu olarak açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu hayvan türü ve yaşam evresi ayrımını eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır; genel yavru, başka kuş yavrusu veya deve yavrusu anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımına dayanır ve herhangi bir özel söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır.

facets.statement: Türü deve kuşu olan genç yavruyu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adın deve kuşunun yavrusunu bildirdiği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız deve kuşunun genç yavrusu adlandırıldığında eksiksiz ve doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü ve yavruluk evresini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlı bir cümlede deve kuşunun yavrusundan söz edilirken doğal sözcük sırasını sağlar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve kuşu türünü ve yavruluk durumunu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız deve kuşu yavrusunu adlandıran tek anlamlı kullanım burada esastır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deve kuşu yavrusunun yanında küçük develeri ve hizmetçileri de kapsayan daha geniş bir anlam kümesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: deve kuşu yavruları ve başka topluluklar
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırma alanında iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütünüyle deve kuşu yavrusuna bağlıdır; komşu dal aynı karşılığın yanında tür ve insan bakımından başka anlamlara da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavruluğu özellikle deve kuşu türüne bağlayan özel bir addır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan, evcil hayvan ve yabanıl hayvan yavrularını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğumdan sonraki genç ve küçük yaşam evresini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür bakımından özeldir; komşu dal pek çok canlı türünün yavrusunu içine alan genel sınıf adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; çok anlamlı yakın ad ile genel yavru adı, tür ve kapsam sınırlarını en yararlı biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعول بمعنى الرأل، ولد النعام.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل الدويبة ولا الجعل النخل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعول ولد النعام (maqayis)؛ الجعول الرأل ولد النعام (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sözün bir yer adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir ve bundan başka bir yer kimliği veya genel anlam vermez. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırlı tanıklığı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adın gösterdiği belirli yer açıklanmadığı için tanım bir yer kimliği uydurmaz ve sözü genel yer anlamına dönüştürmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli ad biçimine bağlıdır; genel veya yalın bir yer anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Kaynağın yalnızca bir yer adı olduğunu bildirdiği, gösterdiği yer açıklanmayan özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kimliği belirtilmeyen bir yer için kullanılan özel addır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu kullanım tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlıdır ve yerin kimliğine ilişkin ek bir ortak açıklama bulunmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynağın belirli yer kimliğini açıklamadan yalnızca yer adı diye sınıflandırdığı bu özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adı olma bilgisini ve yer kimliğinin belirtilmemiş oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün genel yer anlamı taşımadığı, yalnız özel ad olarak kullanıldığı açıklanırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü kimliği belirtilmemiş özel bir yer adı olarak korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; adayların her biri başka ve belirli bir yer adını veya genel yer alanını gösterir, ancak odak adın hangi yerle özdeş olduğunu kanıtlamaz; bu yüzden yayımlanabilir bir karşıtlık seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعلة حين يصرح المصدر بأنها اسم مكان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعلة الواحدة من النخل الصغار.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç nitelik birlikte kurucudur; yalnız kısa, yalnız şişman veya yalnız inatçı olan biri bu dalın tam kapsamına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın betimleyici kullanıma dayanır ve özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını anlatan nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Kısa, şişman ve tartışmada inatla direnen kişiyi üç niteliği birlikte taşıyarak betimler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu birleşik kişi betimlemesi tek bir tanıklığa dayanır; kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte verilir.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişide beden kısalığı, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte anlatıldığında tam karşılık verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçılığın birlikte bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üç niteliği birlikte taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi belirleyen üç kurucu niteliğin tümünü birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şişmanlık ile tartışmada inatla direnme niteliklerini kısalıkla birlikte gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalın, güçlü ve toplu beden yapısını bildirir, fakat inatçılığı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kısa ve toplu beden yapısına sahip kişiyi betimlemede iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel kısalık ve şişmanlığa davranışsal inatçılığı ekler; komşu dal ise bedensel kalınlık ve gücü öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısalık ve inatçı çekişkenliği şişmanlıkla birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda bedenin dolgunlaşıp yağlanmasını anlatır, boy ve huy koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Şişmanlık ve beden dolgunluğu anlam alanında iki dal buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üçlü bir kişi niteliğidir; komşu dal yalnız bedensel dolgunluğu seçer ve farklı canlı türlerine de uygulanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kısa ve toplu kişi betimi ile genel beden dolgunluğu, üç niteliğin birlikte bulunması koşulunu en açık biçimde ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, doğuran anneyi yakın ve uzak soy çizgisinde kapsar; ayrıca bir kadının anne oluşunu ve birini anne gibi besleyip büyütmesini açıkça belirtir. Bu nedenle annelik, yalnız biyolojik bağ değil, annelik işlevini üstlenmeyi de içeren tek bir çekirdek çevresinde kurulabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek annelik ve annelik işleviyle sınırlıdır; aynı kökün topluluk, inanç yolu ve soru bağlacı anlamları buraya girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anne anlamını ve ona bağlı biçimleri kapsar; övgü ya da yergi bildiren kalıp söz yalnız kendi kullanım sınırında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğuran kadın ya da soy bakımından daha uzaktaki kadın ata ve onun üstlendiği annelik konumudur. Bir kadının anne hâline gelmesini ve birini anne gibi besleyip büyütmesini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Doğuran anne ile yakın veya uzak kadın ata aynı temel annelik konumunda adlandırılır.
Bir kadının anne olması ve birini anne gibi besleyip büyütmesi annelik işlevinin uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklarda ortak çekirdek temel anne anlamıdır; çoğul biçimler, anne olma, yakın ve uzak kadın ata kapsamı ve anne gibi besleyip büyütme ayrıntıları kaynak kümesinde ayrı katkılar olarak tanıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Doğuran kadın, kadın ata veya anne gibi bakım veren kişi söz konusu olduğunda çekirdeğin tamamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Doğurma bağını, kadın ata kapsamını ve besleyip büyütme işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğuran kadın veya kadın ata için doğal ve kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel annelik bağını ve kadın ata kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin biyolojik bağdan bağımsız olarak annelik bakımını üstlenmesini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Besleme, bakım ve büyütme yoluyla annelik işlevini üstlenmeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da doğuran anneyi ve anne çoğullarını temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol anne adını ve biçimlerini öne çıkarırken odak kol annelik konumuna geçişi ve annelik bakımını da anlam alanına katar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأم الوالدة القريبة والبعيدة، وجموع أمهات وأمات، وصيرورة المرأة أما، والتغذية والتربية على صورة الأم، وما جرى من صيغ لا أم لك وويل أمه وهوت أمه في المدح أو الذم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه معنى الأمة للجماعة أو الدين، ولا الإمام، ولا حرف أم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأم الواحد والجمع أمهات وربما قالوا أم وأمات وفلانة تؤم فلانا أي تغذوه وتربيه (maqayis)؛ الأم معروفة (jamhara)؛ الأم الوالدة والجمع أمات وأصل الأم أمهة لذلك تجمع على أمهات وأمت المرأة صارت أما (sihah)؛ الأم بإزاء الأب وهي الوالدة القريبة والبعيدة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, çevresindeki şeyleri kendinde toplayan şeyi ve bir şeyin varlık, yetişme veya düzelme bakımından kaynağını aynı adlandırma altında birleştirir. Dalın kaynak, başlangıç, toplayıcı odak ve dönüş noktası çerçevesi bu ortak ilişkiyi doğru temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, bir şeyin kaynağı veya çevresindekileri toplayan odağıyla sınırlıdır; doğuran anne doğrudan bu dalın konusu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel kaynak ve toplayıcı odak ilişkisi korunur; şehir, kitap ve başka ad tamlamalarındaki özel karşılıklar yalnız bağlı oldukları yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin doğduğu, başladığı, yetiştiği veya düzeldiği kaynak ya da çevresindeki bağlı unsurları kendinde toplayan ana odaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin başlangıcı ve varlık kaynağı bu adlandırmanın temelidir.
Çevresindeki veya kendisine bağlı unsurları toplayan merkez de aynı kaynak ilişkisiyle adlandırılır.
Yetiştirme ve düzeltmenin dayandığı başlangıç noktası da kaynak kapsamına girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak kümesinde köken ve başlangıç yönü ile çevredeki veya bağlı unsurları toplayan merkez yönü birlikte tanıklanır; bu yönler her kaynakta zorunlu ortak bileşim olarak verilmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin başlangıcı ile ona bağlı unsurların toplandığı yer veya dayanak birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç, varlık kaynağı ve bağlı unsurları toplama ilişkilerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin varlık veya başlangıç noktası öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç ve varlık dayanağı olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Çevredeki bağlı unsurları kendinde toplama yönünü tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevresindeki yerleri veya parçaları kendinde toplayan odak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlı unsurları toplama ve merkez olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Varlık ve yetişme kaynağı olma yönünü zorunlu olarak anlatmaz.
